notes: No public vendor CAD, STL, STEP, GLB, or USDZ model for the INHECO Single Plate Incubator Shaker stack surfaced in web search, so this package uses a representative fallback mesh instead of implying factory-exact geometry.
The fallback chooses a three-unit stack of the shaker MP module because it is the most explicitly documented stack form and best matches the driver's stacked thermoshaker/incubator intent.

Per-unit tray heights are anchored to the driver's `incubator_shaker_mp` loading-tray z reference of 51.2 mm; front/tray x positions are centered because the official sources do not publish a left-right tray-center offset.

The tray and front-face access frames are integration-friendly estimates derived from official dimensions and brochure imagery and should be refined if service drawings or direct measurements become available.
